<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> can be obtained by either purchasing it from [[Clotho]] the witch (tier 1), or through the practice of [[Alchemy]] at the [[alchemy workbench (tier II)]]. Its primary use relates to the production of the embalming fluid [[acid injection]].  It also has a one-time use during the [[Astrologer]]'s quest in order to read some of the damaged sections of the [[keepers journal]].
